name: Getian
bio: Archetype: Reality Damage Bonus, Cycle-Based. ⌽ Inflicts [Shape of Bones] with S1 and Insight 3 passive. Enemies with [Shape of Bones] have reduced Reality DEF and take additional Genesis damage when attacked. ⌽ Gains [Eureka] with S2 and Ult. Consumes [Eureka] to attack all enemies with [Shape of Bones]. ⌽ Ultimate generates an Array that buffs DMG Bonus for all allies, Reality damage gains additional DMG Bonus. ⌽ Synergy: Reality Damagers (Jessica, Spathodea, etc.)
